title: [New Game]: 'Signal Relay' — Optical Fiber Wavelength Splitter and Prism Routing Puzzle
body:
## Problem
ArcadeVerse players enjoy cerebral grid routing puzzles, yet there is no game centered around additive RGB optical beam splitting, color-filter gates, and multi-frequency receiver synthesis.

## Architectural Scope & Requirements
1. **Complete Standalone Playable Game (`games/signal-relay/` — Minimum 350+ LOC across game engine, level solver & UI):**
   - `games/signal-relay/game.json`: Complete valid manifest (`id: "signal-relay"`, category, difficulty, controls). **Do NOT manually edit `assets/js/games-registry.js`**, as CI auto-compiles it.
   - `games/signal-relay/index.html` & `style.css`: Responsive viewport-fitted puzzle stage with level selector, move counter, beam trace legend, and reset/undo controls.
   - `games/signal-relay/game.js`:
     - Implement grid ray-tracing engine propagating discrete RGB bitmask beams (`R=1`, `G=2`, `B=4` -> Cyan/Yellow/Magenta/White combinations) with cycle-detection guard against infinite mirror loops.
     - Support interactive rotatable/movable optical components: 45-degree Mirrors, 50/50 Beam Splitters, RGB Wavelength Filters, Additive Combiners, and Target Receiver Sensors.
     - Include at least **10 progressively challenging handcrafted levels** with localStorage completion & par-move star tracking.
2. Pure Vanilla JS/HTML5 Canvas/CSS3 + Web Audio click/chime feedback, zero external assets/CDNs, zero Unicode emojis.
3. Add unit test `scripts/test-signal-relay.js` validating RGB color mixing logic, infinite mirror-loop termination safety, and verifying all 10 levels have valid grid bounds and solvable component configurations.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] All 10 levels render crisply on desktop and mobile screens and complete accurately when receivers match target wavelengths.
- [ ] Infinite mirror feedback loops are cleanly detected without hanging the browser.
- [ ] Progress and star ratings persist in `localStorage`.
- [ ] Complete game + unit tests total 350+ meaningful lines; `games-registry.js` and other protected root files are NOT modified.
- [ ] Test script `scripts/test-signal-relay.js` passes under `node`.

title: [Feature/Audio]: Procedural Schroeder Algorithmic Reverb, Early Reflections and Stereo Chorus Rack
body:
## Problem
Synthesized 8-bit and chiptune sounds often feel dry without spatial depth. Building a real-time Schroeder algorithmic reverb and stereo modulated chorus rack purely from Web Audio primitive nodes (`DelayNode`, `BiquadFilterNode`, `GainNode`) gives ArcadeVerse studio-grade spatial DSP without downloading external impulse-response `.wav` files.

## Architectural Scope & Requirements
1. **Substantial Implementation Scope (Minimum 250+ LOC):**
   - Create `assets/js/schroeder-reverb-rack.js`:
     - Build complete Schroeder/Moorer reverb topology in Web Audio API: Early Reflections multi-tap delay line -> 4 parallel feedback Lowpass-Damped Comb Filters (mutually prime delay lengths scaled by Room Size) -> 2 series All-Pass Diffuser stages -> Wet/Dry equal-power crossfader.
     - Add parallel modulated Stereo Chorus stage using dual LFO-modulated short delay lines (`15ms–30ms`) panned Left/Right for rich width.
     - Include built-in test signal generator (Impulse Click, Dry Synth Pluck, Drum Hit) + live Impulse Response Envelope visualization canvas.
   - Create `assets/css/schroeder-reverb-rack.css`:
     - Studio rack faceplates with knobs/sliders for Room Size, RT60 Decay Feedback, High-Frequency Damping, Pre-Delay, Chorus Depth/Rate, and Wet/Dry Mix.
2. Pure Vanilla JS/Web Audio API (zero external `.wav` IRs or DSP libraries), zero emojis.
3. Add unit test `scripts/test-schroeder-reverb-rack.js` validating mutually-prime delay time scaling, stability bounds ensuring feedback gain `< 1.0` (preventing runaway oscillation), equal-power wet/dry gain curves, and headroom node wiring.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Parallel comb + series all-pass network produces lush, metallic-free algorithmic reverb tail cleanly.
- [ ] Feedback gains remain strictly bounded (`< 0.96`) under all slider extremes to prevent audio blowup.
- [ ] Built-in test plucks and impulse visualization let users audition Room Size and Chorus live.
- [ ] Codebase exceeds 250 lines across isolated files without touching protected files.
- [ ] Test script `scripts/test-schroeder-reverb-rack.js` passes under `node`.

title: [Feature/Audio]: Real-Time Autocorrelation Pitch Chromatic Tuner and Harmonic Overtone Scope
body:
## Problem
While basic canvas visualizers draw raw waveform lines, estimating accurate musical pitch (`A4 = 440Hz`, cents deviation `-50` to `+50`) and separating harmonic overtone structure requires real-time digital signal processing algorithms like Normalized Square Difference / Autocorrelation (YIN-style).

## Architectural Scope & Requirements
1. **Substantial Implementation Scope (Minimum 250+ LOC):**
   - Create `assets/js/autocorrelation-tuner.js`:
     - Implement pure JS time-domain Normalized Autocorrelation / Difference Function pitch detector (`detectPitch(float32Samples, sampleRate)`) with parabolic peak interpolation achieving sub-Hertz precision across `60Hz`–`1500Hz` and RMS silence gating.
     - Implement frequency-to-MIDI/Note/Cents mapper (`440Hz -> A4 +0c`, `442Hz -> A4 +7.8c`) and `AnalyserNode` harmonic bar analyzer.
     - Support BOTH live browser microphone input (`getUserMedia` with graceful permission denial handling) AND built-in adjustable reference tone/synth oscillator test mode so users can test offline without a mic!
   - Create `assets/css/autocorrelation-tuner.css`:
     - Chromatic needle gauge canvas (`-50c` flat to `+50c` sharp), big note readout (`C#4`), frequency Hz readout, and harmonic partial spectrum bars.
2. Pure Vanilla JS/Web Audio API/2D Canvas, zero external DSP libraries, zero emojis.
3. Add comprehensive test suite `scripts/test-autocorrelation-tuner.js` synthesizing exact pure/complex sine buffers (`110Hz`, `261.63Hz C4`, `440Hz A4`, `880Hz`) in Node and asserting pitch detection within `+-1.5` cents accuracy plus silence rejection.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Pure JS autocorrelation detector identifies synthetic and live audio frequencies accurately in cents.
- [ ] Chromatic needle gauge animates smoothly and turns emerald green within `+-5` cents in-tune range.
- [ ] Graceful fallback works seamlessly with built-in reference tones when mic access is unavailable/denied.

title: [Feature/Audio]: Multi-Band 3-Way Crossover Compressor, Limiter and Analog Soft-Clipper Mastering Rack
body:
## Problem
Web Audio synthesis chains often clip harshly or lose punch across bass vs highs. Implementing a true 3-band Linkwitz-Riley style crossover dynamics processor teaches and provides real mastering dynamics control (Low/Mid/High compression + final soft-clipping brickwall limiter).

## Architectural Scope & Requirements
1. **Substantial Implementation Scope (Minimum 260+ LOC):**
   - Create `assets/js/multiband-mastering-rack.js`:
     - Route audio through 3 cascaded `BiquadFilterNode` crossover bands (`Low < LowMidHz`, `LowMidHz..MidHighHz`, `High > MidHighHz`) each feeding an independent `DynamicsCompressorNode` (Threshold, Ratio, Attack, Release, Makeup Gain) summed into a custom `WaveShaperNode` hyperbolic-tangent (`tanh`) analog soft-clipper & ceiling limiter.

## Problem
Real-time 2D geometric optics—tracing rays through angled mirrors, dielectric glass blocks, circular lenses, and refractive prisms that split white light into rainbow spectra via wavelength-dependent Snell's Law dispersion—creates a captivating physics & graphics sandbox missing from ArcadeVerse.

## Architectural Scope & Requirements
1. **Substantial Implementation Scope (Minimum 280+ LOC):**
   - Create `assets/js/optics-prism-sandbox.js`:
     - Implement exact analytical ray-segment and ray-circle intersection solver supporting iterative reflection/refraction ray tree expansion (depth cap `<= 8` bounces) using Snell's Law `n1*sin(theta1) = n2*sin(theta2)`, Fresnel reflectance splitting, and Total Internal Reflection (TIR)!
     - Implement multi-wavelength Cauchy chromatic dispersion (`7` spectral bands Red -> Violet with slightly shifting refractive indices `n(lambda)`) so white laser beams fan into vibrant rainbow spectra exiting triangular glass prisms!
     - Allow dragging/rotating Mirrors, Triangular Prisms, Biconvex Lenses, and Laser Emitters directly on Canvas.
   - Create `assets/css/optics-prism-sandbox.css`:
     - Dark optical-bench canvas with tool palette (`Add Laser`, `Add Mirror`, `Add Prism`, `Add Glass Circle`), IOR slider, Dispersion toggle, and preset configurations (`Rainbow Prism`, `Fiber TIR Guide`, `Kaleidoscope Hall`).
2. Pure Vanilla JS/2D Canvas, zero external geometry libraries, zero emojis.
3. Add unit test `scripts/test-optics-prism-sandbox.js` verifying Snell's law refraction angle accuracy, Total Internal Reflection cutoff beyond critical angle `arcsin(n2/n1)`, and ray-segment intersection edge cases.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] White beams entering glass prisms split accurately into fanned rainbow spectral rays via Snell dispersion.
- [ ] Total Internal Reflection traps angled beams cleanly inside glass guides/blocks.
- [ ] Rotating or dragging optical elements updates all downstream rays smoothly at 60 FPS.
- [ ] Implementation exceeds 280 lines across isolated files without modifying protected files.
- [ ] Test script `scripts/test-optics-prism-sandbox.js` passes under `node`.

title: [Feature/Core]: Fixed-Point Q16.16 Arithmetic Math Engine and Cross-Browser Lockstep Checksum Verifier
body:
## Problem
IEEE-754 floating-point math (`Math.sin`, `Math.cos`, `Math.sqrt`) can drift slightly across different CPU architectures and browsers, breaking deterministic game physics replays and lockstep multiplayer. ArcadeVerse lacks a zero-float fixed-point `Q16.16` math library and deterministic checksum verification harness.

## Architectural Scope & Requirements
1. **Substantial Implementation Scope (Minimum 280+ LOC):**
   - Create `assets/js/fixed-point-lockstep.js`:
     - Implement integer-only `Q16.16` fixed-point arithmetic (`SCALE = 65536`) using `Math.imul` / `BigInt`-safe 64-bit intermediate products for `mul`, `div`, integer `sqrt` (bitwise digit-by-digit), deterministic CORDIC / LUT `sin`, `cos`, `atan2`, and 2D fixed-point vector helpers (`Vec2FP`).
     - Implement deterministic Mulberry32/XorShift32 PRNG + CRC32 state-snapshot checksum (`crc32(int32Array)`) plus a live visual Demo Harness running twin physics-particle arenas side-by-side (Native Float vs Deterministic `Q16.16` Lockstep) verifying frame-by-frame checksum parity!
   - Create `assets/css/fixed-point-lockstep.css`:
     - Split simulation diagnostic panel showing side-by-side frame tick counters, live hex CRC32 state hashes (`0x8F3A19C2`), precision error delta vs `Math.sin`, and benchmark throughput comparison.
2. Pure Vanilla JS/2D Canvas, zero external math/crypto libraries, zero emojis.
3. Add comprehensive test suite `scripts/test-fixed-point-lockstep.js` validating `Q16.16` `mul`/`div` accuracy, integer `sqrt` exactness (`sqrt(fromInt(25)) === fromInt(5)`), CORDIC trig error bounds (`< 0.002`), overflow guards, and identical 1,000-tick CRC32 lockstep replay hashes.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Integer-only `Q16.16` operations execute without `Math.sin`/`Math.cos`/`Math.sqrt` floating-point drift.
- [ ] Twin 1,000-frame lockstep simulation replays produce bit-exact matching CRC32 checksums every run.
- [ ] Unit tests verify arithmetic precision, division-by-zero guards, and trig accuracy rigorously.
- [ ] Codebase exceeds 280 meaningful lines across isolated files without editing protected core files.
- [ ] Test script `scripts/test-fixed-point-lockstep.js` passes cleanly under `node`.
